project.title: Inclusive Hospitality Internship Programme Design
project.objective: Design and pilot an inclusive internship programme in hospitality services for students from diverse backgrounds, aligned with education policy and evidence-based social research.
deliverables: Needs assessment report on inclusive internships in hospitality
Programme framework and policy brief for the internship scheme
Operational handbook for hotel staff hosting interns
Training and communication materials for students and staff
Monitoring and evaluation plan with survey tools
constraints: Programme framework draft due within 10 days
Must comply with education and labour regulations for internships
Limited budget for on-site training materials and events
Data collection must follow privacy and research ethics standards
Hotel operations cannot be disrupted during peak hours
All outputs must be understandable to non-specialist stakeholders

risks.risk: Low engagement from hotels to host interns due to perceived operational burden.
risks.mitigation: Create a concise operational handbook, highlight benefits, and propose a small-scale pilot with clear support.

risks.risk: Students from target groups may be reluctant to participate.
risks.mitigation: Co-design communication with student reps, ensure clear information on support, and gather anonymous feedback early.

risks.risk: Regulatory or institutional approval for the programme is delayed.
risks.mitigation: Involve education policy officer early, prepare a short policy brief, and align documents with existing frameworks.

risks.risk: Data collection tools are too complex for hotel staff and students.
risks.mitigation: Pilot test surveys and interview guides with a small group and simplify wording based on feedback.

risks.risk: Media or public misinterpret the programme objectives.
risks.mitigation: Prepare clear key messages and a Q&A, and route external communication through the journalist role.

themes.why_relevant: Sociologists and lecturers must ground the internship model in data and research, not assumptions.
The education policy officer ensures the programme fits existing education and labour rules.
The hotel porter provides realistic input on daily routines and what interns can safely do.
The team must ensure the programme is accessible and supportive for diverse student groups.
The journalist crafts messages so stakeholders understand goals and avoid misinterpretation.
Clear indicators and tools are needed to assess the pilot and justify scaling the programme.

backlog.task: Conduct rapid needs assessment on inclusive hospitality internships
definition_of_done: At least 6 stakeholders (students, hotel staff, education staff) interviewed or surveyed
Key barriers and opportunities summarised in a 3-4 page report
Findings shared in channel and referenced in programme framework draft

backlog.task: Draft internship programme framework and policy brief
definition_of_done: Framework includes objectives, eligibility, roles, and safeguards
Policy brief (max 4 pages) aligned with current education and labour regulations
Feedback from at least one sociologist and one higher education lecturer incorporated

backlog.task: Design operational handbook for hotel staff hosting interns
definition_of_done: Handbook outlines daily tasks suitable for interns and supervision guidelines
Includes simple checklists for onboarding and shift routines
Reviewed by a sociologist for inclusion and by education policy officer for compliance

backlog.task: Develop research design and evaluation tools for the pilot
definition_of_done: Clear evaluation questions and indicators defined
Draft pre- and post-internship survey and interview guide created
Ethical and privacy considerations documented and approved by higher education lecturer

backlog.task: Prepare training session outline for students and hotel staff
definition_of_done: Two separate session outlines: one for students, one for hotel staff
Learning objectives and activities listed for each session
Materials requirements documented and shared with team

backlog.task: Create communication plan and key messages for the programme
definition_of_done: Key messages and FAQs drafted for students, hotels, and public
Draft announcement text and short article outline prepared
Reviewed by education policy officer for alignment with policy brief

backlog.task: Map and engage potential partner hotels for the pilot
definition_of_done: List of at least 3 potential hotel partners compiled
Initial outreach messages sent or planned
Feedback from at least one hotel contact summarised in channel

backlog.task: Simplify and adapt materials for non-specialist audiences
definition_of_done: Executive summaries created for framework, handbook, and evaluation plan
Language checked for clarity and accessibility
Team signs off that summaries reflect original content accurately

backlog.task: Align internship activities with academic requirements
definition_of_done: Mapping document linking internship tasks to learning outcomes created
Credit or recognition options described
Shared with education policy officer and sociologists for comments

backlog.task: Pilot test survey and feedback tools with a small group
definition_of_done: At least 3 mock respondents complete the survey
Feedback on clarity and length collected
Survey revised and final version stored in shared location

backlog.task: Document operational risks and mitigation strategies for hotels
definition_of_done: List of at least 8 common operational risks identified
Practical mitigation steps described in simple language
Section integrated into the operational handbook

backlog.task: Compile pilot implementation summary and recommendations
definition_of_done: Key findings from evaluation tools and hotel feedback summarised
Recommendations for scaling or adjusting the programme listed
Summary shared in channel and linked to all core artifacts

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, objectives, and initial roles for the internship programme.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the project and asking for confirmation of scope and roles.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the final objective statement and success criteria for the pilot.
Agree on which hotels or types of hotels to target for the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Co-create the internship framework and ensure policy and academic alignment.
threads_plan.trigger: Education policy officer shares first draft outline of the programme framework.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the structure of the internship framework (duration, roles, safeguards).
Decide how internship activities will map to academic requirements.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define practical hotel operations, intern tasks, and risk mitigation.
threads_plan.trigger: Hotel porter posts a draft list of feasible intern tasks and daily routines.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the final list of tasks interns are allowed to perform in hotels.
Confirm risk mitigation measures and onboarding steps for hotels.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize evaluation tools and data collection approach for the pilot.
threads_plan.trigger: Sociologist shares draft evaluation plan and survey templates for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final set of indicators and survey questions for the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on communication strategy and public narrative for the programme.
threads_plan.trigger: Journalist posts draft key messages and communication plan for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on key messages and decide which channels to use for announcements.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async check-in where each role posts progress on their assigned tasks and blockers.
Weekly review thread to validate drafts of key artifacts and capture decisions in one summary message.
Post-pilot reflection thread to document lessons learned and recommendations for scaling.
Ad-hoc clarification mini-threads when hotel operational constraints or policy questions arise.
